source: Main checkout combines reviewed Rust installation/config maintenance, GPU presentation and Ouroboros workflow patches with current annotation/session work. Pinned backend and four protected Rust inputs preserved.

producer.checks: Formatting; strict default/evidence workspace Clippy; workspace and evidence-feature tests; default/evidence x64+i686 application and observer builds; x64 Doctor.

data_approved: New matching exact-user/PID Agent policy ACK before connection; capture/app-preferences false and session-control true.
Matching Output worker ACK commits A Back-to-F5 while B remains legacy.
After six selection inputs exact owned PIDs confirmed; complete native A F5 and B F6 DOWN/UP pairs plus one primary pair each; no Back leak, no held inputs.
Exact-PID GPU status reports direct_composition_d3d11 and positive upload/present/commit counters, no fallback.
Fresh explicit Home Stop reports stopped/error-free/targets-empty/can_start, both known cursor HWNDs absent before GUI close, probe holds empty and descriptor removed.
Actual stopped Save/Load in isolated config root with spaces preserves full profile except intended A output rule; disk SHA unchanged across Load; no unexpected transfer/CWD profile writes.

direct_original_review.decision: APPROVED: readable From/To selected users and both down-caret affordances; whole Add edge and disabled Apply controls visible.
direct_original_review.limit: Long bottom status/footer text clips; footer readability and full compact UX are not certified. PNG cadence metadata is not request-associated freshness proof.

remaining_limits: One bounded default-x64 combined slice only; i686 built/hash-checked, not executed.
GPU reporting is not GPU pixel/performance validation.
No shipping/installer, full UX/Ultra/P1, hardware, arbitrary-app, same-process or desktop-wide isolation acceptance.
independent_native_review.reviewer_actions: Read-only artifacts/source/process inventory and direct original image review; no app/native/Cargo/test reruns.

shipping_acceptance: OPEN: combined producer is source/build qualification; final distribution provenance and focused package smoke remain pending
scope: Frozen packaging, UX and GPU isolated assessments retain their own source identities and limits. This bounded default-x64 smoke does not replace their full gates or establish desktop-wide/same-process isolation.
